verdict.rationale: Airbyte Core is open source and self-hostable (docker/abctl, Kubernetes), moves data into open destinations (warehouses, databases, data lakes) and offers PyAirbyte/API/Terraform for programmatic extraction and automation, all supporting data portability and freedom to self-host and leave. However there's no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export everything and migrate away' workflow, and community evidence notes Airbyte is not fully open source ('freemium... non-free parts you are not allowed to use'), which tempers the openness claim. missing for 10: dedicated data-export/migration-away documentation, and resolution of community claims about non-free/gated components.
